name: JetSydney
blurb: A full-service Australian carrier connecting Sydney and its wider domestic network with Europe, North America, Oceania and beyond.

about: JetSydney is an Australian full-service international airline founded in 1946 and headquartered in Sydney. Owned by JetSydney Group, it combines Australian hospitality with a modern, diverse fleet serving domestic, Oceanian and long-haul markets.

Following decades of development, JetSydney has established itself as a major fictional aviation brand and continues to expand its international reach while strengthening connections between Sydney and the rest of the world. JetSydney — Exploration YES!
network: Sydney is the main hub, supported by Melbourne and Perth. Key services include Sydney–Sunshine Coast, Sydney–Singapore and Sunshine Coast–Singapore.
